newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank says no changes in rates.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank says no changes in rates.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Friday it had not changed its overnight borrowing and lending rates, which are currently at 10 percent and 12.75 percent, respectively.
Speculation was rife in the market that the Central Bank may again cut its overnight rates after it lowered the borrowing rate on its term reverse last Thursday.
Its five-day, one-month and two-month reverse repos all carry a rate of 10 percent.

Moreover, dealers believe the Central Bank would have to align its rate after the benchmark 91-day T-bill rate fell to a single-digit level of 9.804 percent, lower than the Central Bank's overnight borrowing rate of 10 percent. Just last Friday, the Central Bank slashed its overnight borrowing rate by 0.25 percentage-point, causing some arbitrage money to depart from the market.
